column1: # Authored expectation for the Phase-4 test-surface join.
# Section S clause 2: the run enumerates its test surfaces and joins them completely to an
# independently authored expectation. The surface names are the phase's own vocabulary; the
# ids are the metric keys the Gate-1 battery is obliged to record, read off this phase's
# contract rather than off any implementation output.
# owner is the registry the ids are enumerated from at run time:
#   metrics   the metric keys in gen/dhall/gate1/phase-results.tsv
#   checks    the check ids tools/phase4_gate.py implements
# `gate2-residue` and `runtime-fidelity` name metrics whose recorded value is the literal
# `UNVERIFIED`. They are listed so the ledger carries them explicitly — this register
# reaches neither, and a ledger that omitted them would read as though it had.
